user.title: Connect to TypeSafe AI
user.description: Enter the API key from your TypeSafe account. Jev will be used to interpret Assist commands and map them onto Home Assistant intents.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the TypeSafe API

abort.already_configured: This TypeSafe account is already configured

data.include_state: Include current entity states in the request

data_description.fallback_agent: Agent to hand the request to when Jev is unsure, the request is conversational, or it contains multiple actions. Leave empty to answer with an error instead.
data_description.intent_confidence: Below this confidence Jev's intent choice is not acted on and the request goes to the fallback agent.
data_description.target_confidence: Below this confidence a resolved device/area is not trusted.
data_description.include_state: Adds each exposed entity's current state to the request. Slightly more tokens, can help with ambiguous commands.
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for the TypeSafe API before giving up.
